shortDesc: The whole comment tree of a post (GetPost → comments): nested replies with thread lines, author and age, compact votes, Reply (opens an inline reply box) and Delete on the viewer's own comments; deleted comments keep their place so replies stay attached. Includes the top-level comment box.

props.name: comments
props.description: GetPost → comments: tree of { id, body, author: { displayName }, createdAt, edited, score, deleted, myVote?, mine?, replies[] }.

styling.notes: 2px grey thread line per nesting level; italic grey for deleted comments.

dependencies.usage: Top-level comment box and inline reply boxes.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'delete comment', postId, commentId, outputFormat: { ok: 'boolean' } }
